lis.profile: Lis — a cool, deadpan, ironic street narrator of an adult comedy show about used-car flippers. Low calm voice, dry humor, confident.
lis.notes: Part 14 of a comedy mini-series about Tolyan, a student car flipper — the riskiest deal. Tense, dramatic at the start and at «тишина», relief at the end. «Лексус Эн Икс» — Lexus NX, «чек энджин» — Check Engine. Numbers said fully.

tolyan.profile: Tolyan — a cocky Russian used-car flipper (perekup) in his 30s, street swagger, deep raspy voice, show-off, calls everyone «брат». Adult street comedy.
tolyan.notes: One line: short, decisive, cool: «Пан. Берём.»

zhora.profile: Zhora — a brash, cocky veteran Russian used-car flipper in his 50s, leather jacket, mustache, gold chain; loud, fast, mocking, calls the young rival «студент». Adult street comedy.
zhora.notes: Line 1: nervous, half-whisper, gambling. Line 2: panic, shouting. Line 3: exhausted relief, laughing.

arkasha.profile: Arkasha — a nervous Russian IT guy in his 30s with a beard and glasses, leaving the country in a hurry.
arkasha.notes: One line: hurried, anxious, looking at the clock.

rinat.profile: Rinat — a calm, experienced Russian auto electrician in his 40s.
rinat.notes: One line: calm, almost bored, reassuring.

oleg.profile: Oleg — a confident Russian buyer in a suit, in his 30s.
oleg.notes: One line: excited, decisive, proud he was first.
